en: Vintage monochrome postcard with a decorative river-themed border. The central photograph shows a group of African children and an adult standing on a sandy riverbank beside a very large crocodile lying on the ground and chained. Palm trees and a calm river curve into the distance. At the lower left a drawn vignette continues the river scene, and at the bottom are illustrated water plants. Text is printed in red and black around the image.
